items.text: 6+ years of product management, with at least 2 on internal operations or back-office platforms.
Experience in a regulated financial domain such as payments, lending or fund administration.
Track record of writing requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria with engineering.
Hands-on use of data (SQL or similar) to find root causes and size problems.
Own the roadmap for reconciliation and exception-handling tools used by Operations.
Partner with Compliance and Risk to ship controls without slowing payouts.
Coordinate UAT and launch readiness across Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Experience applying LLMs or automation to manual operational work.
